title: PROSE Repository Template Library
description: Shared protected HTML templates loaded by the PROSE Sovereign Editorial Suite from the ProReSources GitHub Pages repository.

templates.title: Professional Résumé
templates.description: A comprehensive résumé framework with professional summary, strengths, experience, achievements, education, service, and technical or creative tools.

templates.title: Cover Letter
templates.description: A professional application letter connecting relevant accomplishments, organizational understanding, and the value the applicant brings.

templates.title: Resignation Letter

templates.title: Letter of Recommendation
templates.description: A detailed recommendation structure based on relationship, observed strengths, specific evidence, character, growth, and fit.

templates.title: Employment Offer Letter
templates.description: A structured employment offer covering role, schedule, compensation, benefits, responsibilities, conditions, policies, and acceptance.

templates.title: Curriculum Vitae
templates.description: A comprehensive academic, artistic, research, teaching, and professional CV with publications, presentations, grants, service, and credentials.

templates.title: Professional Biography

templates.title: Personal Statement
templates.description: A personal statement framework connecting formative experience, preparation, values, fit, contribution, and long-term direction.

templates.title: Scholarship Essay
